title: Erdős–Rubin–Taylor conjecture on planar graph choosability
statement: A **planar graph** is a graph that can be drawn in the plane without crossings. **Erdős–Rubin–Taylor's conjecture.** Every planar graph is 5-choosable. Since planar graphs are 5-degenerate, they are immediately 6-choosable; the conjecture was later proved by Thomassen, who established the stronger 5-choosability result.
source_name: Nandana K Vasudevan, K Somasundaram and N Narayanan, “List-Coloring and Chromatic-Choosability – A Dynamic Survey”, arXiv:2606.31702 (2026).
